svg.title: AppointEase - final S6.1 package correction, nine integrated GoF patterns

g.text: AppointEase - final S6.1 package correction, nine integrated GoF patterns
Validated spec construction via Builder and polymorphic creators.
Concrete subtype retained by lifecycle replacements.
Transitions return replacements; original never changes.
validateReschedule returns a slot proposal; reschedule a detached replacement.
Repository owns atomic reservation/collision checks and revisions/events.
Reject DST gaps; select earlier instant in overlaps.
Working boundaries use the same explicit resolution.
Products share mode and factory-instance identity.
Concrete product records are nested inside their factory.
All reads and read/validate/replace commands use one instance lock.
Catalogs and returned snapshots are immutable.
Capture clock once per command; failure leaves map unchanged.
All nine patterns and interactive console implemented.
One shared dispatcher per repository; callbacks after store unlock.
S6.1 verified acyclic packages; stop after S6.1.
